toy_pop_n.estimand: Size of the synthetic finite population (a design choice of the illustration)
toy_pop_n.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_reps.estimand: Number of simulated repetitions of the same sampling design
toy_reps.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_sample_n.estimand: Sample size of each simulated stratified sample (a design choice)
toy_sample_n.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_truth.estimand: Share of the synthetic population's adults lacking a regular source of care: the finite-population proportion, computed exactly
toy_truth.note: Known exactly because the whole synthetic population is in hand.
toy_truth.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_unweighted.estimand: Share of the synthetic population's adults lacking a regular source of care: unweighted sample mean, one simulated sample
toy_unweighted.note: Rural adults are half the sample but a fifth of the population.
toy_unweighted.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_unweighted_avg.estimand: Share of the synthetic population's adults lacking a regular source of care: average of the unweighted mean over repeated samples
toy_unweighted_avg.note: Average over 2,000 repetitions of the stratified design.
toy_unweighted_avg.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_weighted.estimand: Share of the synthetic population's adults lacking a regular source of care: Hajek weighted mean, one simulated sample
toy_weighted.note: SE from the stratified with-replacement (Taylor) formula on this one sample; identical to svy's declared-design SE (dual-path check in manifest).

toy_weighted_avg.estimand: Share of the synthetic population's adults lacking a regular source of care: average of the weighted mean over repeated samples
toy_weighted_avg.note: Average over 2,000 repetitions of the stratified design.
toy_weighted_avg.source: Synthetic population defined in ch00-start-here/build.py (seed 20260910); no survey data

toy_weighted_sd.estimand: Share of the synthetic population's adults lacking a regular source of care: standard deviation of the weighted mean across repeated samples
toy_weighted_sd.note: The repeated-sampling spread that a design-based SE estimates.
